name: Lethal ‎‎Ape R Mods
summary: Lethal ‎‎Ape R Mods combines the intense, physics-based movement of Gorilla Tag with horror survival gameplay. Players must navigate eerie, abandoned environments while evading one thing: scary baboons. They’re fast, relentless, and smarter than you'd like. Run, climb, and scream, because once a scary baboon locks eyes on you, it’s already too late.
